Built a complete, playable 3D Halloween game in `index.html`: roam the pumpkin patch, collect 10 candies, dash past ghosts, and survive the 60-second countdown. It includes keyboard and mobile touch controls, lives, score and timer HUD, and replay screens.

Verified the game renders and starts in Chromium. Assumption: “3d Halloween” meant a spooky 3D collection game. The Three.js module loads from a CDN, so gameplay requires an internet connection.
